propositions: When rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP and run against a project without docs/, explain guide lookups fail with missing-file because guides are resolved from the consuming project's repo_root, not the rebar package.

The explain_guide() and explain_criterion() functions must resolve guides via in-package importlib.resources instead of repo_root-relative paths to guarantee accessibility from any rebar installation.
Guide markdown files (writing-a-passing-plan.md, passing-code-review.md) must be packaged as part of the rebar distribution in src/rebar/_guides/ and shipped by Hatchling in the wheel.
The AUTHOR_GUIDES configuration must map guide names to bare filenames for resolution via resources.files('rebar._guides'), removing the repo_root_path parameter from explain_guide().
Explain criterion rendering must use the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() rather than reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md from the consuming project.
Thin pointer files in docs/ must remain for backward-compatibility with existing links while the canonical guide content lives in-package.
